topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I can't shake the weight in my chest as I step past thenow-empty space where my favorite restaurant used to stand. The sign is gone, the windows bare, like faces stripped of smiles. I remember the hum of the place, the warm lamplight casting gold shadows over tables crowded with people laughing, plates bearing the flavors that became my solace. Now, it’s as if a door that led to my own private haven has been sealed shut, and I’m left here, wandering in the cool echo of its absence. The streets around it start to blur, the buildings losing their shape, as if the world itself is struggling to hold form without this place. I keep walking, the evening stretching out long and thin, hoping something will feel right again.
